demoBypass: This is a demo tour — listing details and contract sections are hidden. Use the stage walkthrough above to explore the collaboration lifecycle.

pending.title: Pending Acceptance
pending.body: This collaboration is waiting for the host to review and accept your application.
pending.notified: Notification sent to host — they'll be prompted to review your application.

withdraw.title: Withdraw proposal?
withdraw.body: This permanently removes your proposal from your collabs. This can't be undone.

accepted.title: Deliverables In Progress
accepted.body: The host has accepted! Share a link to your Google Drive or Dropbox folder so the host can preview your work.
accepted.tooltip: Be sure that the link is editable by the host.
accepted.resend: Need to update the link? Enter a new one above and click "{{action}}" to resend to the host.
accepted.integrations: Future integrations with Frame.io, Wipster, and more on the way.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.body: Adjust the deliverables agreed upon in the Collabnb Agreement. The host will be notified of any changes.

uploaded.title: Uploaded

items.drive: All files uploaded to shared drive

uploaded.ai: AI content analysis and performance projections coming soon.
uploaded.hint: Complete all checklist items to request approval.

closed.title: Close Collaboration
closed.body: Both parties rate each other to confirm the close — this closes the collaboration and releases payment.
closed.howWasIt: How was the collaboration? Your rating confirms your close.
closed.commentPlaceholder: Share a few words about the experience (optional)
closed.instaSoon: Instagram API integration coming soon — metrics will update automatically.
closed.howDidPost: How did your Collabnb post perform? Your data stays private and helps us improve matches.
closed.tagUs:
Tag us when you post — it helps hosts spot your work on the platform.
Instagram: tag @collabnb in the caption and add us as a collaborator.
TikTok: tag @collabnbofficial in the caption.
closed.paymentsBody: Collabnb will handle payouts, invoicing, and tax forms so you can focus on creating. Payment processor integration is on the way.
closed.bothConfirmed: ✓ Both parties confirmed — collaboration will be archived
closed.trustpilotEmail: We've also emailed you a Trustpilot review link.

archived.title: Archived Collaboration
archived.body: This collaboration has been completed and archived. Use the timeline above to revisit any stage, or view the listing details below.

contractSummary.heading: Contract Summary
contractSummary.body: This collaboration agreement is between {{hostName}} and {{creatorName}} regarding {{propertyName}} located in {{location}} from {{dates}}. The creator agrees to deliver {{deliverables}} as compensation for {{payment}}.

terminate.title: Terminate collaboration?
terminate.body: This permanently removes this collaboration from your dashboard. This can't be undone.
terminate.bodyAccepted: This collaboration has been accepted, so it can only end if the host agrees too. They'll be asked to confirm.
terminate.hostRequested: The host has asked to end this collaboration. It stays active until you agree.
terminate.awaitingHost: Termination requested — waiting on the host to confirm.
